node.title: XR low-core oriented-difference puncture compiler
node.statement: Fix a repeated oriented support difference (X,Y) of width h+1<=t<=K-1 in a globally generic P-B family. Factoring the full locator of X turns its residual common supports into a globally generic low-core RS-line instance on D minus (X union Y), with parameters (N-2t,K-t,A-t) and unchanged excess h; the Y-side gives a simultaneous second instance. The reduced affine error rank is at most K-t+1, so the all-LineRay bound gives fiber size at most C(K-t+1+N-A-t,K-t+1). The boundary widths t=K-1,K-2 cost less than n^3 per fixed difference at every official row. No difference-type aggregate, CAP25 local locator-SPI bound, or P-B slope count is claimed.
